build_waveglow_vocoder: build a WaveGlow vocoder model with configurable n_flows, n_group, and WaveNet layer settings
infer_audio_from_mel_spectrogram: infer audio waveform from a mel spectrogram using the WaveGlow infer method with sigma noise scaling
compute_waveglow_loss: compute the WaveGlow loss from model output including latent z, log scale, and log determinant values
create_invertible_1x1_conv: create an invertible 1x1 convolution layer that computes forward convolution and log determinant of weight matrix
remove_weightnorm_from_waveglow: remove weight normalization from all WaveNet layers in a trained WaveGlow model for inference optimization
